title: Product
description: A product on the shopfloor. Its state says whether it exists as a physical item: 'uninitialised' before it has been produced, 'initialState' while it lies on the floor, and 'consumed' once a station has used it up as a recipe input. A product that does not exist has no position, so xpos and ypos are null; only while the state is 'initialState' do they say where it lies. Only workstations and the transporter change these Properties.

xpos.title: Position on the x axis
xpos.description: Where the product lies on the x axis, or null while it has no position — it has not been produced yet, or a station has consumed it.

ypos.title: Position on the y axis
ypos.description: Where the product lies on the y axis, or null while it has no position — it has not been produced yet, or a station has consumed it.

state.title: Production state
state.description: 'uninitialised' until the product has been produced, 'initialState' while it lies on the floor, 'consumed' after a station used it as a recipe input.

madeFrom.title: Made from
madeFrom.description: The ids of the products a station consumed to produce this one, in recipe order; empty until it has been produced, and always empty for a raw material.
